CLOUD REVIEWER seat for PR #2527 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head d809c1f30f02b417dfd2d29ac5a98b6dd2803a55. Bus nonce: 3417d19a57ee47d2124a34be56bab9b1. Never send push notifications.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md and its rules from main, and follow them exactly. Fetch the PR head with `git fetch origin d809c1f30f02b417dfd2d29ac5a98b6dd2803a55`; the PR body is in the PR. Verify each claim adversarially: mutate the fix and check the tests fail, and check every figure in the body at this head. Check that it merges with origin/main (`git merge-tree --write-tree`) and read CI on this head from the check-runs API.
Output: in a fresh directory of your own (`W=$(mktemp -d)`), write verdict.md, whose first line is exactly `Fix review: merge d809c1f30f02b417dfd2d29ac5a98b6dd2803a55` or `Fix review: blocked d809c1f30f02b417dfd2d29ac5a98b6dd2803a55 <class>: <reason>` (no brackets; the class is lower-case letters and dashes), in the format the role file gives, then a blank line, then `bus-nonce: 3417d19a57ee47d2124a34be56bab9b1`; put the evidence in `ev/` beside it. Do NOT run bus.sh: its dispatch record lives on the orchestrator's machine, which publishes the verdict there (cloud_relay.sh). Return the verdict on a probe ref, and push nothing else; this builds one parentless commit with a private index and touches no branch of your checkout: `R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); G=$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir); mkdir -p $W/pr && cp -r $W/verdict.md $W/ev $W/pr/ && cd $W/pr && T=$(GIT_DIR=$G GIT_INDEX_FILE=$W/idx GIT_WORK_TREE=$W/pr sh -c 'git add -A -f . && git write-tree') && C=$(GIT_DIR=$G git -c user.name=seat -c user.email=seat@users.noreply.github.com commit-tree $T -m "verdict 2527 d809c1f30f02b417dfd2d29ac5a98b6dd2803a55") && git -C $R push -q origin $C:refs/heads/probe/rev-2527-3417d19a`. That ref is the return signal. Do not post comments, approve or merge.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Fix reviewer for PR #2527 (topic r10-freq-defrost, defrost-fold fix). Round 3: the previous review blocked metric-gamed at d0cdac2e (a reflow of _freq_view that lowered the structure metric without removing code). The fixer says: reflow reverted, _freq_view byte-identical to base, structure budgets back to main's table, no re-record, _freq_fold_blocked now owns the defrost term and calls _cop_fold_blocked. Verify with the finder's harness the group brief names, never the fixer's: the freq_map defrost fold counts (base 8 -> head 0, clean 8 -> 8), that structure.py reads the same 18299/8541/718 as the merge base, that re-wrapping lines moves it (null control), and the mutants. Open question for you to rule on: is _freq_fold_blocked (module-level helper near line 1000 of coordinator.py) inside the seam the architect note allows. A red nightly-status grades main and is not this PR unless its diff reaches what that check reads. Your ev/ MUST contain a file holding the full 40-hex head sha (ev/HEAD.txt).
